name: notify-buffer-chunk1226
note: Notify stacking, fade, and the centered stack suffix from c_notifybuffer.cpp (1-220).
auditSeams: Identical text pops the previous line only while its ticker is still below the timeout. A fading copy starts the count over at 1. The pop happens before the status bar can swallow the add, so a swallowed duplicate is still removed. Print flags are masked with 1023 before the base add. con_scaletext below 0 becomes 0. Shift keeps the tail when the line cap shrinks and ignores a negative cap. Fade uses j/6 only while j is below 6. Pulse multiplies by 0.7 plus 0.3 sine of the millisecond clock over 100. A print level at or above 5 uses the untranslated color and does not index the color table. The stack suffix is drawn only on the last row when the count is above 1, and centering divides the drawer width by the scale before subtracting the combined width. If every row is idle or expired, Top snaps to TopGoal.
auditRationale: UNCredited c_notifybuffer.cpp 1-220 (+220). The file ends at 220. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/console/c_notifybuffer.cpp --start 1 --end 220 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
